title: 13 Best Herbal Essential Oils For Upper Abdominal Pain
intro: Herbal essential oils for upper abdominal pain are plant-based extracts that have been traditionally used to alleviate discomfort and pain in the upper abdominal region. Additionally, other herbal essential oils such as fennel oil, dill oil, and anise oil can also be used to treat upper abdominal pain due to their carminative properties, which help to release trapped gas and alleviate bloating.
